sources.note: Main homepage. Describes PracticeStudio as a certified complete EHR with integrated PM, 25+ years experience, touch-based charting, e-prescribing, scheduling, billing, DataVault backup, and patient portal.
About page. MicroFour has 25+ years experience, uses StrataFrame proprietary framework, products used in all 50 states.

Feature overview. Lists touch screen EHR, claims management, e-prescribing, point-of-sale, inventory tracking, visit statistics, scheduler. Built on .NET/SQL Server. Specialties: cardiology, chiropractic, dermatology, family medicine, internal medicine, urgent care.

ONC certification details. Certificate 15.04.04.1985.Prac.20.00.1.180810. Lists all certified criteria, 30 CQMs, Surescripts certification for RxWriter, phiMail for DIRECT messaging, HL7 4010/5010 support. Month-to-month contract.
Specialty selection page. Emphasizes customized specialty-specific workflows, touch-based charting, out-of-the-box templates.
Patient portal details. Hosted at v2.patientwebportal.com. Secure messaging, CCD sharing, email notifications, two-way communication, DIRECT SMIME support.
Family practice specialty page. Describes charting, e-prescribing, scheduling, lab integration, claims/remittance processing, custom reporting, cloud and server options.
Corporate site for MicroFour. Confirms Amarillo TX headquarters, EHR and software focus.
Third-party EMR review site. Describes PracticeStudio features including lab integration, document management, scheduling, and multi-specialty templates.
Third-party software listing with feature overview and pricing information for PracticeStudio.
